evidence.excerpt:
We are now accepting nominations for the $1,000 Fred J. Epstein Youth Achievement Award and $500 Special Recognition Award.  The awards will be given to students 19 or younger who have demonstrated initiative, talent and determination resulting in a notable accomplishment in any field—including art, music, science, math, athletics or community service.  Honorable Mentions will also be awarded.

The awards will be presented at the annual Smart Kids with Learning Disabilities Gala on April 10, 2025 at the Woodway Country Club in Darien, Connecticut.  Transportation and hotel accommodations will be provided for the winning student and their parents.

# 2025 Fred J. Epstein   Youth Achievement Awards

Each year, Smart Kids with Learning Disabilities® recognizes students from all over the country who have achieved great success despite or because of their learning challenges. The Fred J. Epstein Youth Achievement Awards celebrate the outstanding accomplishments of young people with LD and ADHD who have done amazing things, making a lasting impact on their schools and communities. Many are poised to go on to bigger and better achievements in college and workplaces across America.

Page 1: The Whitefish Police Protective Association (WPPA) is offering two $1000.00 scholarships to a graduating Whitefish High School senior. The recipient will be selected by the Application Committee based on need, academic standing and completed essay. Applicants must have their completed application turned in by April 15th.
Eligibility: Whitefish High School senior; high school grade point average of 2.5 or higher and plans to be enrolled as a full-time college or trade school student. Include current High School transcript and two reference letters.
Page 2: Blank activities/honors, community activities, universities/trade schools applied to, confirmed acceptance, GPA, impact-of-scholarship statement, applicant signature, work experience fields. References section: Please list three references.
Page 3: Essay on the importance of law enforcement in today's society and its impact in your life. Award winner's $1000 check issued in recipient's name and forwarded to enrolled college/university/trade school. Completed applications may be hand delivered or mailed to Whitefish Police Department.
